programmatic_metadata.name: Semantic Scholar API
programmatic_metadata.description: Citation and metadata API for verification and enrichment. Check current unauthenticated limits and key eligibility in Semantic Scholar's API documentation before bulk citation chasing.

programmatic_metadata.name: OpenAlex
programmatic_metadata.description: OpenAlex permits basic keyless requests; a free key raises the daily budget 10x. Budget/rate exhaustion returns 429. Verify current allowances at https://help.openalex.org/api/authentication/ (checked 2026-09-11; page updated 2026-08-19).

discovery_tools.name: Semantic Scholar
discovery_tools.description: Paper discovery with citation graphs and metadata

discovery_tools.name: Hugging Face Papers
discovery_tools.description: Daily paper highlights and community discussion; primary replacement for Papers with Code social signal

discovery_tools.name: Hugging Face Trending
discovery_tools.description: Trending models, datasets, and spaces; useful for code-release signals alongside HF Papers

discovery_tools.name: Connected Papers
discovery_tools.description: Visual exploration of related papers and prior work

discovery_tools.name: alphaXiv
discovery_tools.description: Social signal layer on top of arXiv: comments, trending papers, and discussion threads. Use as a pre-triage filter before deep API triage.

discovery_tools.name: Emergent Mind
discovery_tools.description: Aggregates arXiv paper signals from X (Twitter), Reddit, GitHub, and HN. Free tier. Useful for identifying papers with broad cross-community attention early.

discovery_tools.name: arxiv-sanity-lite
discovery_tools.description: Karpathy's SVM-based arXiv recommender. Learns from papers you mark as interesting; good for personalised daily digests.

discovery_tools.name: ResearchRabbit
discovery_tools.description: ResearchRabbit announced a Litmaps partnership and optional premium tier. Check the current feature and plan details before relying on them. https://www.researchrabbit.ai/announcement-researchrabbit-release-2025.

discovery_tools.name: Litmaps
discovery_tools.description: ResearchRabbit announced a Litmaps partnership and optional premium tier. Check the current feature and plan details before relying on them. https://www.researchrabbit.ai/announcement-researchrabbit-release-2025.

discovery_tools.name: Zeta Alpha
discovery_tools.description: Neural search over arXiv and other AI/ML preprint sources. Free web interface; useful for semantic queries that keyword search misses.

discovery_tools.name: codesota.com
discovery_tools.description: Leaderboard and benchmark lookup for code-related tasks. Use for state-of-the-art comparisons previously served by Papers with Code leaderboards.

dead_or_changed.name: Papers with Code
dead_or_changed.description: DEAD as of July 2025. paperswithcode.com now 301-redirects to Hugging Face Trending; GitHub data is frozen. Replaced by: HF Papers (huggingface.co/papers) for social signal, HF Trending (huggingface.co/trending) for code-release signals, and codesota.com for leaderboard lookups.

dead_or_changed.name: arXiv export API endpoint
dead_or_changed.description: Operator terms require at most 1 request / 3s, single connection, across all controlled machines; checked 2026-09-11. No enforcement-start date is established here. Parallel query bursts are the fastest route to a throttle. Replacement: same endpoint; enforce the 3s gap in all query scripts (scripts/generate_arxiv_scout_queries.py reports estimated_min_runtime_seconds for this reason). See references/arxiv-api-guide.md#rate-limiting.

dead_or_changed.name: OpenAlex
dead_or_changed.description: OpenAlex permits basic keyless requests; a free key raises the daily budget 10x. Budget/rate exhaustion returns 429. Verify current allowances at https://help.openalex.org/api/authentication/ (checked 2026-09-11; page updated 2026-08-19).

dead_or_changed.name: Semantic Scholar API
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: an API key is recommended for sustained use and key-approval rules have tightened. Check current rate limits and key eligibility at https://www.semanticscholar.org/product/api before bulk citation chasing; back off on 429. Fallback: OpenAlex, which allows basic keyless queries.

dead_or_changed.name: Connected Papers
dead_or_changed.description: CHANGED: a paid tier exists and the free plan caps searches. Check current plan limits at https://www.connectedpapers.com/ before relying on it; for bulk citation-graph work use the OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar citation graph.

dead_or_changed.name: ICLR / OpenReview
dead_or_changed.description: OpenReview's current API is API 2; the legacy API v1 is still used for some older conferences. Check the venue's API version when verifying acceptance rather than relying on an arXiv comment field.

dead_or_changed.name: ResearchRabbit
dead_or_changed.description: ResearchRabbit announced a Litmaps partnership and an optional premium tier. Check current plan limits at https://www.researchrabbit.ai/ before relying on bulk exports; for programmatic citation-network work use OpenAlex.
